title: SNRA: Spatial Niche Robustness Auditor
description: Software and reproducibility artifacts for a negative-control-aware auditor that certifies, downgrades or blocks spatial omics domain and boundary claims under predefined null, composition, block, subsampling and package-stress controls.
notes: Archived v0.1.0 release DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20110429. Concept DOI for all SNRA releases: 10.5281/zenodo.20110428.
